mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 62 degrees with clear skies and a full moon near the Verona Public Library, and we are seeing a moderate air quality reading of 55.

The City of Verona is inviting residents to help pick the new I Voted stickers for the November election. Students submitted 53 original designs, and you can cast your vote online or at City Hall through August 7 to determine the final four winners.

Today is packed with activities including the Verona Downtown Farmers Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and trivia at Hop Haus.
In a recent incident from July 26, an officer stopped a vehicle for traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway, resulting in the driver being arrested for O W I.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open at 10 AM today.
